jobs.pose: Make a STRONGLY DIFFERENT ACTION POSE: decisive side-on archer shooting to SCREEN LEFT. Left arm extended toward left at shoulder height gripping bow CENTER, right elbow pulled back right and right fingers at cheek drawing the string. ONE arrow points horizontally LEFT with straight shaft aligned from arrowhead past bow handle to rear nock at right cheek hand. ONE bowstring forms TWO taut straight segments in a V from upper left bow tip to right cheek arrow-nock point to lower left bow tip; NO third line, no slack string or duplicated arrow. Clear anatomy shoulder/elbow/wrist; both bow tips fully shown. Torso twists side-on, front knee bends forward left and rear leg braces diagonally right, shallow dynamic lunge not extreme split. Strong horizontal action line, compact whole-body triangle. Simplify dress into SHORT angular green wrap jacket and two very short hip tabs over dark loose riding trousers, REMOVE long side skirt tails; keep short square bamboo-motif shoulder cape swept slightly backward, clear practical waist tailoring and full feminine bust with opaque cloth. Preserve asymmetric black bob, small cheek scar and bold decisive expression. No longer standing and holding arrow at waist.

Make a STRONGLY DIFFERENT PLAYFUL POSE: buoyant three-quarter TURN to SCREEN LEFT, smiling with one playful raised eyebrow. Weight on one foot, other knee bent with foot lifted a little BACKWARD, both complete legs visible and not crossed; dynamic arc through hips and braid. Carry bow casually in ONE lowered hand at side/front with its wooden curve tilted diagonally across low-left empty space, below torso; other hand rests jauntily on hip with elbow out. NO hand-held arrow, all arrows remain safely in small back quiver with three feather ends. At-rest bow has EXACTLY ONE straight taut string between two visible tips, grip at central handle. Dress design becomes rounded APRICOT short puff-sleeve blouse with curving bust seams, sage small round cloud collar, short rounded petal hem and sage knee-length shorts, remove all long cape tails so light round mass feels clearly different from A/B/D. Keep the chestnut coarse side braid swung to side in one large curve, simple apricot tie and bright adult full feminine curves. Broad clean circle/arc shape language with only one motif, not a few-feather version of original A. Both bow tips and feet visible, no loose dangling weapon geometry.

Make a STRONGLY DIFFERENT QUIET POSE: upright relaxed calm body three-quarter SCREEN LEFT, one straight weight leg and other foot slightly behind apart, head mildly tilted looking left with low half-lids. Bow held VERTICALLY at SCREEN LEFT beside body like a tall curved crescent; one lowered arm holding CENTER grip with bow lower tip near ground but visibly separate from boot, upper tip at head height. All bow wood continuous, both tips visible in empty space and one STRAIGHT almost vertical taut string joins their tip nocks. Other hand tucked behind back, NO hand-held arrow; three arrows in simple quiver only. Costume strongly VERTICAL: moon-white high Chinese diagonal-collar fitted jacket, close sleeve on one side, long STRAIGHT open teal-edged coat lapels forming two wide clean rectangular panels rather than flying tails, one large sparse bamboo silhouette at bottom, dark slender riding trousers and simple teal boots. Keep the smooth straight black bob with horizontal fringe and small crescent bamboo half-hat/jade pin. Mature quiet scholarly archer personality, full soft feminine bust shaped under opaque cloth, not a model pout. No lunge, no big fluttering cape or swirling ribbon, vertical calm contrasted with other versions.
